text:
Carmen: Quick sync 7: webinar + benchmark launch next Thurs. We need: X thread, LI carousel (3 variants), 1-pager, paid creative, and clear inbound routing. Who can own what?

Priya: Routing note: webinar form -> Make sure Zapier maps to Salesforce lead queue "SDR-Marketing" + tag "webinar-benchmark-2026". Also add utm_source=linkedin/x for each channel. @Carmen who owns the form?

Ethan: Ill ping legal. They require a short footnote with test topology + dataset. Can someone attach the benchmark raw CSV?
Leo: Uploading charts + csv to /marketing/benchmarks/assets now. Filenames: root-latency.png, cost-95pct.csv.
Priya: Timing proposal: X at 09:30 PT (thread + engage), LinkedIn carousel at 10:15 PT, Paid boost at 11:00 PT. That staggers reach and supports capture. Thoughts?

Sam: SDR rota: Sam 0-2h, Ethan 2-6h, Zoe 6-24h. Make sure leads are in Salesforce with owner assignment.

```text
1/ We ran a public benchmark comparing inference stacks for LLM serving.
2/ Headline: 2x faster gen latency at ~60% lower per-token cost (95th pctile).
3/ Why it matters: predictability at scale = cheaper, faster rollout.
4/ Read the full benchmark + methodology: link
5/ TL;DR: recommended configs and tradeoffs for production.
```

Priya: Also preparing a 24h nurture: immediate thank-you + 24h follow-up with benchmark highlights + CTA to schedule demo. Drafting now.
Ethan: Legal confirmed conditional OK if we include methodology link and avoid "always" phrasing. Ill add a short parenthetical with test conditions to the X thread.
